headline: Gold Holds Near Multi-Month Lows Ahead of US PCE Inflation Data
summary: Gold prices hovered near recent lows as hawkish Federal Reserve signals and expectations of potential rate hikes boosted the dollar, while investors awaited key PCE inflation figures.
why: Precious metals act as traditional hedges against inflation and currency debasement, making them sensitive to US interest rate expectations.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Hawkish Fed expectations and a stronger dollar reduce the appeal of non-yielding bullion.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of further US monetary tightening and anticipation of key inflation data kept downward pressure on precious metal prices.
